exposure: cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate
deliveries with clear amniotic fluid (control group)
outcome: cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate
cohort: 31,536 women with a singleton pregnancy, who underwent trial of labor >24 weeks of gestation, in a single tertiary center, over a six-year period
finding: Thin meconium was associated with adverse obstetrical, delivery, and neonatal outcomes, including meconium aspiration syndrome, intrapartum fever, instrumental delivery, cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate, and respiratory distress requiring mechanical ventilation.
